offers_products.reason: Main offering is gaming and entertainment experiences at casinos; food and beverage are incidental to the casino operation.

offers_services.reason: Operates casinos, hotels and entertainment facilities in Illinois, Mississippi, Indiana, Nevada and Colorado, serving guests.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Casino guests are individual gamblers and visitors who choose to play, dine and stay.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Customers are individual casino patrons; no main business or government buyers are indicated.

recurring_revenue.reason: Regional casinos rely on repeat patrons who gamble frequently, though without contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Gambling, entertainment and hotel stays are discretionary and easily cut when household budgets tighten.

big_ticket.reason: Casino bets, meals and hotel stays are small, frequent purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Revenue comes from gaming machines, tables and casino properties, not mainly from staff time and skill.

large_customers.reason: Customers are individual gamblers and households, not large enterprises or government.

asset_heavy.reason: Owns and builds casino resorts such as American Place and Chamonix, needing heavy property and equipment investment.
